name: Kin Clinic
_plan: Hearthmere's clinic is one room and a kettle. No Roost terminal -- a village of four hundred does not get one, and the keeper says so, which is the first time the player hears that there are bigger places than this.

text: The restorative bank, lamps in green.
Four cradles. Three of them have never been used at once.
The counter, and a kettle on it, which is not regulation.
The keeper has been told about the kettle.
The noticeboard. A rota for the hay. A lost dog, found.
A card from the Stillwater Concord asking anyone who sees kin
moving inland in numbers to report it. It has been there two months.
A table by the window with two chairs and a chessboard.
Nobody is playing. The pieces have not moved since the spring
